brief: Matches regular-expression triggers in a text, runs a piece of code on each match and keeps a log of what changed.
detail: Register triggers (a name and a regular expression), attach code to them that works on the match held in @value, then Process a text. Matches, Triggers, Positions and Results describe the last run, trigger by trigger, and State is a log of the matches whose computed value differs, with timestamp, order, pattern, position, dependson and affects. Build one with StzRxuter(), rxuter() or StzRxu(). Positions count characters and the Hebrew class [א-ת] and emoji patterns work. Found today: GetDependencyChain overflows the stack once the log holds an entry; Positions gives the first occurrence for every copy of a repeated match; only the first code attached to a trigger runs; and a code that raises is silently ignored.
